text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Selmun tragedy: A man and a young woman were killed on Saturday afternoon when they were washed off a rocky ledge at Selmun, 10 miles (16 km) north of Malta. Another three people who were also washed away by the freak wave were rescued.

- Government confirms contract for the building of three ferries. The contract, with a Norwegian firm, was signed just before the October 26 elections. The ferries will be used on service to the sister island of Gozo.

- Nationalist Party to fight government attempts to ban political parties from local council elections. Nationalist Party leader Eddie Fenech Adami gave his warning as the party prepared to fight elections in a third of Malta's local councils next Saturday. The ruling Labour Party is against political party participation in council elections, insisting partisan politics should not be instilled in the councils.
